annotations.title: Calculate IMT and stamp duty on a home purchase

description: Use this when asked what a home purchase in Portugal costs on top of the price: IMT, stamp duty and Casa Pronta registration, by the 2026 tables. Do not use it for the yearly property tax (`imi_annual_cost`) or to define a term such as VPT (`glossary_lookup`). Both taxes are charged on the higher of `value` and `vpt`: pass the VPT when known. `tax_haven_company` takes precedence over `non_resident`. `buyer_is_young` applies only when `primary_home` is true. For a non-resident buyer the answer says what the Tax Authority annuls later on request.

buyer_is_young.description: The buyer is 35 or under on the date of the deed, is buying their first own permanent home, is not an IRS dependant and has owned no residential property in the previous three years. Applies the reduced IMT table and the stamp duty deduction (art. 7.º-A Código do Imposto do Selo; not applied above the second band of the young buyers' table). Only applies when primary_home is true; with primary_home false it is ignored

non_resident.description: The buyer is not and has never been tax resident in Portugal. IMT is then a flat rate with no exemption or reduction — no zero band, no young buyers' table, no stamp duty deduction (CIMT art. 17.º n.º 10); the result says what the Tax Authority annuls on request if the buyer becomes tax resident or lets the home at a moderate rent. A buyer who has already been treated as tax resident pays by the tables: leave it false

primary_home.description: The buyer's own permanent home (habitação própria e permanente); false for a second home or an investment, which has no zero band

tax_haven_company.description: The buyer is a company or other entity with its tax domicile in a country, territory or region on the Portuguese list of more favourable tax regimes, or controlled directly or indirectly by such an entity. IMT is then 10 % with no exemption or reduction (CIMT art. 17.º n.º 4), whether or not it is resident, and it overrides non_resident. Never true for an individual (n.º 7)

territory.description: Mainland Portugal (continente) or the Azores and Madeira (regioes_autonomas), which have their own IMT tables

value.description: Purchase price as written in the contract, in euros; a dot or a space may group thousands (250.000)

vpt.description: Optional. The VPT (valor patrimonial tributário) from the caderneta predial, in euros. IMT and stamp duty are charged on the higher of the price and the VPT (CIMT art. 12.º n.º 1), so pass it when it is known

name: imt_calculate

notary_estimate_cents.description: Euro cents: Casa Pronta registration price

taxable_value_cents.description: Euro cents: the higher of price and VPT

total_cents.description: Euro cents on top of the price

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Calculate IMT and stamp duty on a home purchase
